query: 统计各大区的销售总额
gold_sql: SELECT r.region_name AS 大区, SUM(f.order_amount) AS 销售总额 FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_region r ON f.region_id = r.region_id GROUP BY r.region_name ORDER BY 销售总额 DESC
gen_sql: SELECT dim_region.region_name AS 大区, SUM(fact_order.order_amount) AS 销售总额 FROM fact_order JOIN dim_region ON fact_order.region_id = dim_region.region_id GROUP BY dim_region.region_name
llm_judge_reason: 生成SQL的查询表、连接关系、分组和聚合逻辑均正确，仅缺少金标准中的排序子句，导致结果顺序不同，但不影响核心语义。
